description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans source generator, verifying code generation for serializers, grain proxies, and related features using Roslyn APIs. It includes multiple test cases with source code snippets and logic to run the generator and verify outputs.

classes.name: OrleansSourceGeneratorTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods to validate Orleans source generator behavior.
